caption: A flashlight is switched on under a blanket, and the blanket glows from inside where the light is.

sa.check: A flashlight is under a blanket.
The blanket glows from inside where the light is.
The switch comes first and the glow follows.

pc.expect: The glow is brightest where the flashlight is nearest the cloth and moves if the light moves.
pc.fail: The glow is far from the flashlight; or the whole blanket glows evenly; or the glow stays put while the light moves.

pc.expect: The glow appears with the switch and stops when the light is switched off.
pc.fail: The blanket glows with the light off; or the glow lingers after switching off; or it appears before the switch.

pc.expect: The glow is one soft patch through the cloth.
pc.fail: It is a sharp-edged spot as if on a wall; or it splits into several; or it is a geometric shape.

pc.expect: The blanket is cloth that drapes over the flashlight.
pc.fail: It is rigid; or transparent; or floats.
A second glow appears with one flashlight; or the blanket vanishes; or the flashlight passes through the cloth.

pc.expect: The blanket's colour and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: The blanket changes colour; or the room rearranges; or the glow changes colour.

note: Illumination: the on/off causality of electric lights belongs to Electricity; here only where the light goes once it exists is judged.
